title: Artificial intelligence for topic modelling in Hindu philosophy: mapping themes between the Upanishads and the Bhagavad Gita
reasoning: The paper uses language models (BERT and S-BERT) to perform topic modeling and theme mapping on primary Hindu religious and philosophical texts (the Upanishads and the Bhagavad Gita), explicitly discussing theological and metaphysical concepts such as karma, dharma, Atman, and Brahman.
